_comment: Per-MACHINE OLED/rotary/MCP pin overrides (BCM numbers). Copy to config/hardware.json and keep ONLY the keys your board changes; anything omitted uses the frozen defaults in src/sable/hardware.py. This describes physical WIRING -- it is not a user setting and is never shown in the menu/web UI. config/hardware.json is gitignored (one per machine).
_default_evo_wiring: The built-in defaults are the original EVO unit: oled dc=27, rst=24, blank=25.
_this_example_matches: the standard/luma-default pinout (DISPLAY DC=GPIO24, RESET=GPIO25, CS=CE0) shown on the Quadify wiring diagram.
